confirmed_implementation_defects.defect: AffineBasisDecoder.encode used basis transpose as an inverse after training made the basis non-orthogonal.
confirmed_implementation_defects.fix: least-squares inverse using the basis Gram matrix with Cholesky and pseudoinverse fallback; cross-basis projection uses the same inverse
confirmed_implementation_defects.impact: old compact directional reconstruction mean cosine changed from -0.300842 to 0.520331, revealing both the implementation bug and the remaining subspace limitation

confirmed_implementation_defects.defect: raster_adjoint metadata claimed per-view normalization while the actual per-pixel features were not normalized
confirmed_implementation_defects.fix: apply and validate per-view feature normalization before exact contribution aggregation

confirmed_implementation_defects.defect: cosine-only field and compression gates left feature amplitude unidentified even though the frozen nonlinear readout is scale-sensitive
confirmed_implementation_defects.fix: all new gauge experiments gate cosine and absolute log norm error; future training must bind the gauge before readout training

confirmed_implementation_defects.defect: formal capability caches and support graphs could be combined without a full global row authority
confirmed_implementation_defects.fix: bind full xyz, valid/global rows, and their SHA-256; reject partial/nearest/zero-filled formal combinations

confirmed_implementation_defects.defect: continuous diffusion could silently inherit release-compatible edge binarization
confirmed_implementation_defects.fix: continuous formal kernels fail closed when a binarization threshold is present; release reproduction remains isolated

field_d_label_free_capacity.interpretation: multi-view directions contain real information that no single center can retain

native_unit_gauge_whole_neighborhood.cause: directional unit vectors replaced base-field features with L2 norm about 1 while the frozen readout was trained around a much larger field gauge

naive_mode_max.cause: existential max systematically raises background responses and destroys unary calibration

first_principles_conclusion.representation: a task-sufficient primitive field must separate semantic direction, amplitude/reliability gauge, multi-view dispersion, and boundary relation evidence
first_principles_conclusion.readout: a distribution cannot be converted to a calibrated unary by an unconditional max or a globally aligned prototype index
first_principles_conclusion.training: feature gauge must be fixed during field and globally clean readout training; post-hoc rescaling around an already-trained nonlinear readout is insufficient
next_mainline: train a globally clean SurfaceRegion readout on explicitly L2-normalized semantic directions with reliability/amplitude supplied as separate channels
add label-free view-dispersion and boundary-balanced hard-negative ranking without a second full feature field
for SPIn/NVOS, keep strict one-field and target-RGB-compatible tracks separate; use target-view conditioning only when the protocol grants that observation
